name: A 20-year-old RPG Maker game remade with the latest RPG MAKER UNITE and available for free?! ~The Heroes of the RPG Maker series vs. the Demon Lord~
detailed_description:
◆A Game Created 20 Years Ago, Now Remade with the Demon Lord as the Star!

The legendary game born 20 years ago with RPG MAKER 2000 is making an unexpected comeback with the latest RPG MAKER UNITE! (This is the storyline setting, and the RPG MAKER UNITE version is real!)

But it’s not just a simple remake—this time, the main character is the Demon Lord!

The legendary heroes who have colored the history of RPG Maker, transcending time and the boundaries of works, are gathering and beginning their fierce assault on the Demon Lord’s castle!

As the player, you will defend against them as the Demon Lord. Can you withstand the heroes’ fierce attacks and maintain the dignity of the Demon Lord’s army?

◆A Surprising Combination of Tower Defense × Shooting!?

This game, made with RPG MAKER UNITE, is a tower defense shooting game utilizing Unity’s features!!
Repel the heroes who attack one after another with magic, traps, and the monsters of the Demon Lord’s army!

Recruit monsters to build the ultimate formation!

Use the shooting elements to attack and scatter the heroes!

The heroes will attack with a variety of skills and equipment. Depending on your monster formation, create your own strategy to defeat the heroes who will attack one after another!

◆ Don’t Miss the Treasure Chests on the Map!

When it comes to adventure, treasure chests are a must! But these treasure chests in the game aren’t just item supply points...

Surprisingly, the treasure chests also contain comments from RPG MAKER series developer Mr. Ojima Yoji!

There are some never-before-released behind-the-scenes stories, so fans of the series definitely should check them out!
